Description: Synthetic row. Shows the column names and types that ingest_local_data.py reads: the Description column is what becomes chunk text, and Metascore / User Score are carried into chunk metadata rather than into the text itself.

Second synthetic row, present so the sample exercises the multi-row path. Note the Artist column carries a leading 'by ' which _clean_artist strips -- a real quirk of the source data that the sample deliberately reproduces.
Third synthetic row. Duplicate artists across rows are normal in the real dataset and are why the ingester deduplicates before chunking.
